text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r c-o-m-p-i-l-e-d a d-r-a-f-t of r-e-l-a-b-e-l-i-n-g d-i-r-e-c-t-i-v-e-s and l-e-f-t a s-t-a-n-d-a-l-o-n-e m-e-m-o f-i-l-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a-u-t-h-o-r-i-t-y a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l c-h-e-c-k-s
2) the a-c-t-o-r e-d-i-t-e-d s-e-q-u-e-n-c-i-n-g l-o-g-s to c-l-o-s-e r-e-c-o-r-d g-a-p-s and l-e-f-t a m-o-d-i-f-i-e-d d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e e-x-p-o-r-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l r-e-c-o-n-c-i-l-i-a-t-i-o-n
3) the a-c-t-o-r c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-d s-h-i-p-p-i-n-g r-o-u-t-e-s with p-h-a-r-m-a-c-y c-o-n-t-a-c-t-s and l-e-f-t a c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-i-o-n c-a-l-e-n-d-a-r while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p-s
4) the a-c-t-o-r t-i-m-e-d d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-i-o-n b-a-t-c-h-e-s to o-v-e-r-l-a-p i-n-s-p-e-c-t-i-o-n d-a-y-s and l-e-f-t a s-c-h-e-d-u-l-i-n-g n-o-t-e-b-o-o-k while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-y n-o-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n r-e-q-u-i-r-e-m-e-n-t-s
5) the a-c-t-o-r d-i-s-c-a-r-d-e-d o-r-i-g-i-n-a-l c-o-l-d-c-h-a-i-n m-o-n-i-t-o-r d-a-t-a to r-e-d-u-c-e t-r-a-c-e a-b-i-l-i-t-y and l-e-f-t a d-e-l-e-t-i-o-n l-o-g e-n-t-r-y while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g r-e-t-e-n-t-i-o-n p-o-l-i-c-y v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n

note: all p-l-a-n-n-e-d a-c-t-i-o-n-s w-e-r-e t-h-e-o-r-e-t-i-c-a-l-o-n-l-y d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-e-d i-n t-h-i-s e-x-h-i-b-i-t; no r-e-a-l-p-r-o-d-u-c-t w-a-s r-e-l-a-b-e-l-e-d, s-e-r-i-a-l-i-z-e-d, o-r d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-e-d.
